title: Monitoring, SLOs and operational reconciliation alerts
workflow: Define risk-based service and reconciliation objectives
Instrument API, database, broker and reconciliation checkpoints
Detect late journal projections, duplicate events and unresolved payments
Classify severity separately for availability, confidentiality and finance
Route incidents to authorized operations and financial control
Measure actual recovery and review false positives/coverage
invariants: Green uptime chart cannot prove ledger correctness
Unreconciled settlement must trigger independent finance review
Metrics exclude secrets and unnecessary personal data
SLO values require tested bank-specific baselines
Alert delivery itself must be monitored and redundant
Critical fraud or ledger alert cannot be silently disabled
planned_tests: No customer document content in trace
approval_gate: Operations/finance agreed SLOs, real telemetry instrumentation, alert tests and incident-runbook owners.
